subject: mathematics
title: The Endless Ray
objective: Recognize and describe points, lines, line segments, rays, and special line relationships.
introduction: Milo draws roads on a map. Which endpoint or arrow helps you name each road mark?

vocabulary.definition: An exact dot on a paper or screen that marks a specific location.
A straight path with two definite endpoints that stop.
A straight path with one starting point that goes on forever in one direction.
A straight path with no endpoints that goes on forever in both directions.

activities.instruction: Watch how endpoints and arrows identify the road figures.
activities.content: A dot marks one location. A segment stops at two endpoints. A ray starts at one endpoint and continues with an arrow. A line has no endpoints; parallel lines stay apart, while perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.

items.prompt: Which figure goes on forever in one direction?
items.explanation: A ray has one endpoint and goes on and on in one direction, so ray XY is the answer.

items.prompt: Which pair of lines crosses to make a square corner?
items.explanation: Perpendicular lines meet at a square corner, like the edges of this page.

items.prompt: Which drawing shows a line segment?
items.explanation: A line segment is straight with two endpoints, and segment PQ shows that.

items.prompt: How many endpoints does a ray have?
items.explanation: A ray has exactly one endpoint, and it continues in one direction from there.

items.prompt: What is the correct name for a single exact location?
items.explanation: A point marks one exact location, so it is called point M.
